text:
oliver: Heads-up — after the strict fncall schema rollout we have a small but steady stream of rejects for tools.exec-cache in eu-north. Pattern: adapters sometimes return `["ok"]` instead of `[{id:...,value:...}]`. anyone see this?

tess: yep saw the alert. looks like the legacy adapter was optimized to return a short list of keys when values are empty. validator treats it as wrong item type.

amar: log sample: {error:EVAL_22, path:response.items[0], expected:object, got:string, raw:"ok"} — same as you said.

tess: options: 1) pause strict rollout for this route 2) route failing traffic to a permissive variant that soft-coerces 3) add a tiny runtime shim to wrap strings -> {key:string} for this adapter.

console-bot: Suggestion from console: show an inline "mitigation" pill in route list when a route is in permissive mode and expose a small sample of before/after payloads in the inspector. Also add a telemetry dimension `adapter_name` to the validator metrics.

amar: runtime shim is fastest. sample pseudocode: if (item instanceof String) item = {key:item}; This keeps behavior stable and minimal.

ops-bot: Alert: validation.reject rate 0.45% on tools.exec-cache (eu-north) — creating ticket INC-8099.

billing: note: if we enable permissive fallback, we need to mark affected requests for billing review. finance prefers a `billing_review` tag and a daily CSV of request_ids.

tess: pragmatic hotfix: 1) apply shim in runtime for eu-north only 2) add routeOverride to enable permissive variant if reject rate > 0.5% 3) console: show banner and link to incident. Also sample logs to secure bucket for 48h.

amar: I'll push hotfix PR #4210 for the shim and add telemetry tag `soft_coerce=shim` and `coercion_count` increment.

console-bot: We'll add a small banner: "Shim active: string->object coercion on tools.exec-cache (eu-north). Requests with coercions flagged billing_review." We'll also add a chart tile correlating `coercion_count` with `route_variant`.

ops-bot: Update: PR #4210 deployed to eu-north canary at 08:12 UTC. Rejects down ~78% in last 10m. Keeping alert open for 1h.

amar: follow-ups: add adapter CI tests for string/object permutations, and consider a medium-term `soft-coerce+provenance` validator mode so adaptations are visible without opaque rewrites.

oliver: thanks — keeping rollout paused for this route until adapter teams confirm full fix. I'll update the incident channel in 30m. :thumbsup:
